from tools import *
I={'name':'I','kind':'int','bits':8};B={'name':'B','kind':'bool'}
def v(n):return ['var',n]
def c(n,x):return ['const',n,x]
mods=[
 {'name':'e','params':[['a','I']],'result':['r','B'],'requires':None},
 {'name':'f','params':[['x','I']],'result':['r','B'],'requires':['eq',v('x'),c('I',3)]},
 {'name':'g','params':[['y','I']],'result':['r','B'],'requires':['lt',v('y'),c('I',10)]},
]
c1=base(types=[I,B],modules=mods,entries=['e'],pipes=[{'target':'e','filter':'f','bind':{'x':'a'}},{'target':'f','filter':'g','bind':{'y':'x'}}])
for a,flag in [(3,0),(3,1),(5,1),(15,1)]:
 out=run(c1|{'runs':[{'entry':'e','ktest':ktest({'x0':bytes([a]),'x1':b'\1','x2':bytes([flag])})}]});print(a,flag,out['records'])
# deep chain 2000 filters to ensure no RecursionError (build modules many)
N=1500
mods=[{'name':'e','params':[['a','I']],'result':['r','B'],'requires':None}]
# names f0000 etc, each requires true except last maybe constant true
for i in range(N):
 mods.append({'name':f'f{i:04d}','params':[['x','I']],'result':['r','B'],'requires':None})
pipes=[{'target':'e','filter':'f0000','bind':{'x':'a'}}]
for i in range(N-1):
 pipes.append({'target':f'f{i:04d}','filter':f'f{i+1:04d}','bind':{'x':'x'}})
camp=base(types=[I,B],modules=mods,entries=['e'],pipes=pipes)
out=run(camp|{'runs':[{'entry':'e','ktest':ktest({'x0':b'\1','x1':b'\0','x2':b'\0'})}]})
print('deep',out['records'])
